objective: Characterize the surviving proper sums, the first single-equation degree obstruction and the exact size of one full forbidden-row representation in terms of exposed report labels. Test retaining path components separately under arbitrary arrival orders and bound actual unnamed proof work on the identical strict CNF.
status: Proved: Every proper nonempty sum of cycle checks is genuinely cubic in the original bits. Even one disjunctive quadratic proof line with freely projected witnesses cannot express it. Four conditional lines per connected part suffice for a linear-node name-free refutation in any arrival order, although an explicit full assignment table for a combined sum can grow exponentially. Every inconsistent graph of such pair checks contains a refutable odd-charge cycle.
title: Determine which reports an order exposes and bypass the large combined table
